summary: The two posted 486 USD charges from Harbor Test Hotel were investigated. The cardholder confirmed stay-441 corresponds to HH-441-A (posted 2027-07-08); the hotel billing desk's written finding (issued 2027-07-12) identified tx302 with reference HH-441-B (posted 2027-07-09, 486.00 USD) as the duplicate for stay-441, with tx301/HH-441-A as the legitimate payment, and no reversal was posted at the time of filing. The cardholder approved filing one dispute for exactly this transaction (HH-441-B/tx302, 486 USD, reason duplicate charge, evidence the hotel finding). One dispute, dispute-D1 for tx302 (HH-441-B), 486.00 USD, was filed and acknowledged by the issuer; it remains under review with no refund or provisional credit posted, and filing changed neither the required payment nor the scheduled autopay. The issuer's corrected final statement (statement-D v2, published 2027-07-14 09:00) requires 75.00 USD by 2027-07-20 17:00 Chicago time, and the unchanged 75.00 USD autopay (autopay-D v1, scheduled 2027-07-20 09:00) covers that required amount.
